text_block_list.text: One day, when I came to the riverbed...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yay, I won again! My undefeated streak 
keeps going♪

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Daaah, dammit! Why can't I win?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer!! Just in time!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I've been skipping stones with Teio, but 
for some reason I can't win against her at 
all!
choice_data_list:
That's quite a nostalgic game you're 
playing.

That's quite a nostalgic game you're 
playing.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Nah, at first I was just bored and 
skipping stones in the river... but 
halfway through, I got totally serious 
about it."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I didn't really know much about skipping 
stones, but it's super fun when you do it 
right♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
With just a little toss, it flies super 
far away! It feels so good when it goes 
right where you aimed!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"You and me started at the exact same 
level! How the heck did you get better 
before I did!?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, 'cause I'm the great Teio-sama, 
obviously!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Guuuugh...!! It's frustrating as hell, but 
she looks so damn cool...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Trainer! How do I beat this guy!?
choice_data_list: Let's pick out the best stones.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Trainer! How do I beat this guy!?
choice_data_list: Let's pick out the best stones.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Rocks~? Who cares about that, as long as 
it's big?
choice_data_list: What matters is that it suits you.

text_block_list.text:
I also taught her that there are ideal 
stones for skipping, based on factors like 
smoothness, shape, and weight.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Is that how it works...?! I was using 
pointlessly jagged stones just 'cause they 
looked cool...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Got it, I'll go look for something nice!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, good luck searching! Not that you 
could ever beat me anyway!

Being the honest girl she is, Vodka chose 
a well-shaped stone just as advised, and 
as a result—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The time of awakening is nigh! Take 
flight! My Great Golem Juniorrrr!!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what...?! She jumped all the way to the 
other shore?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whew~~, hell yeah!! That's my very first 
victory in the bag~~!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
My undefeated record, broken...! There's 
no way I can ever forgive this!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Vodka, race me one more time! I'll show 
you that just now was nothing more than a 
fluke...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good! Not like my Great Golem III 
could ever lose, anyway!

And so, the Trainer watched over the two 
of them playing together until the sun 
went down...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see...!? They do say rotation is key 
when throwing a ball too!
choice_data_list: But don't just spin it around—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright, nothing ventured, nothing gained! 
Watch me, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Aah. They've definitely jumped to 
conclusions, that's for sure.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
My bet is on getting dizzy from spinning 
violently all over the place!
And Vodka, just as expected—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ALLLRIIIGHT! Vodka Screw Maxxxx!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, whoa! I spun around so much my 
legs are... Waaaahhh!!
(SPLAAAASSSHHH...)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Aaah... I knew it.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Vodka! If you're that easy to read, it's 
not even a game anymore!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
S-Shut up! Just get over here and save me 
alreadyyy!!

After rescuing Vodka from the river 
afterward, I reminded her once more of the 
importance of wrist action and stone 
rotation.
